openai.responseText:
Here are **55+ options in/around Sarasota** that tend to line up best with your two constraints: **good healthcare access** and **not-crazy HOA/fees**. (In Sarasota proper, truly “low HOA” is often found in **older/villa-style** communities; newer resort-style 55+ typically has **higher monthly HOA**.)

## Best fits (lower fees + solid healthcare access)

### 1) **Strathmore Riverside Villas (Sarasota – near Phillippi Creek)**
- **Why it fits:** One of the more **budget-friendly 55+** picks close to central Sarasota.
- **Fees:** Commonly cited around **$200–$300/month** (varies by building/coverage). ([homesforsaleinsarasotaflorida.com](https://homesforsaleinsarasotaflorida.com/top-55-communities-around-sarasota?utm_source=openai))  
- **Healthcare access:** Short drive to major Sarasota providers/hospitals (including Sarasota Memorial area depending on traffic).
- **Good for:** Buyers who want **Sarasota address + lower monthly** and don’t need brand-new amenities.

### 2) **Sun City Center (about 35–45 min north of Sarasota)**
- **Why it fits:** If your top priority is **lower ongoing fees** and “everything close by,” Sun City Center is a strong value play (but it’s not Sarasota).
- **Fees:** Fee structures vary by neighborhood; there are areas described as **low/no HOA**, plus other sections with additional HOA/maintenance layers. ([explore55plus.com](https://www.explore55plus.com/blog/55plus-communities-in-florida/sun-city-center-kings-point-55-plus-community?utm_source=openai))  
- **Healthcare access:** Sun City Center is known for strong medical convenience (large retiree population + lots of services nearby). ([explore55plus.com](https://www.explore55plus.com/communities-1/sun-city-center?utm_source=openai))  
- **Good for:** **Lowest-cost lifestyle** in the region with heavy retiree infrastructure.

## Great healthcare access, but HOA is usually not “low”

### 3) **Del Webb Catalina (Lakewood Ranch – 55+)**
- **Why it’s popular:** Purpose-built 55+ with big amenities and a strong “active adult” scene.
- **Fees:** Published HOA range around **$335–$409/month** (verify current). ([lakewoodranch.com](https://lakewoodranch.com/our-villages/del-webb/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Healthcare access:** Very good access to medical options in the Lakewood Ranch/Sarasota corridor.
- **Reality check:** This is **reasonable for new 55+**, but usually not “low” vs older communities.

### 4) **Del Webb at Lakewood Ranch (55+)**
- **Fees:** Often described in the **~$330–$390/month** range (varies by home/section and can change). ([55places.com](https://www.55places.com/blog/lakewood-ranch-a-new-del-webb-community-coming-to-florida?utm_source=openai))  
- **Healthcare access:** Similar benefit—close to the Lakewood Ranch/Sarasota medical network.
- **Reality check:** Again, more “mid” than “low.”

### 5) **Pelican Cove (Sarasota area, waterfront; age-restricted rules vary by section)**
- **Fees:** Condos commonly cited around **$500–$800/month** depending on unit and what’s included. ([zachosre.com](https://zachosre.com/pelican-cove-sarasota-floridas-best-budget-friendly-waterfront-community/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Healthcare access:** Excellent for south Sarasota convenience.
- **Reality check:** Usually **not low HOA**, but sometimes attractive if you want **waterfront + tons included**.

---

## To narrow this to the *best* 3–5 for you
Tell me:
1) **Buy vs rent?** (Most “55+ communities” searches mix active-adult ownership with senior-living rentals.)  
2) Target **max HOA/fees**: under **$250/mo**, **$350/mo**, or **$450/mo**?  
3) Preferred hospital access: **Sarasota Memorial**, **Doctors Hospital**, or **Lakewood Ranch Medical Center**?  
4) Home type: **villa/condo** (often lower upfront, higher HOA) vs **single-family** (often lower HOA, more upkeep).  

If you answer those, I’ll give a short ranked list with **drive-time-to-hospital**, typical fee ranges, and what to verify in the HOA docs (CDD, special assessments, reserves, insurance).

gemini.responseText:
Sarasota is one of the top retirement destinations in the U.S. due to its high concentration of medical facilities and variety of 55+ living options. "Low" HOA fees in Sarasota typically range from **$400 to $650 per month**, which often include maintenance, cable, and water.

Here are the best 55+ communities in Sarasota that balance healthcare access with manageable fees:

### 1. Cascades at Sarasota
This is widely considered one of the best "resort-style" values in the area. It offers single-family homes rather than just condos or villas.
*   **HOA Fees:** ~$450 – $580/month (varies by home size; includes cable/internet and full lawn maintenance).
*   **Healthcare Access:** Located near the **Sarasota Memorial Health Care Center at University Parkway** (outpatient, imaging, and urgent care) and about 20 minutes from the main SMH hospital.
*   **Why it’s a top choice:** It is gated and has a massive 25,000 sq. ft. clubhouse with an indoor/outdoor pool, but avoids the high "CDD" fees found in newer Lakewood Ranch developments.

### 2. Strathmore Riverside Villas
If you want to be close to the water and the city center, this is a prime location. It consists of one-story villas on 60+ acres.
*   **HOA Fees:** ~$625/month (includes water, sewer, trash, cable, and exterior maintenance).
*   **Healthcare Access:** Only **5 miles from Sarasota Memorial Hospital** (consistently ranked as one of the best hospitals in the world). It is also very close to the Doctors Hospital of Sarasota.
*   **Why it’s a top choice:** It features a private marina and boat docks (on a first-come basis) for a much lower cost than typical waterfront communities.

### 3. Tallywood
Tallywood is a "hidden gem" condo community located in the heart of Sarasota, making it one of the most convenient for frequent medical visits.
*   **HOA Fees:** ~$450 – $640/month (includes roof replacement, building insurance, and basic utilities).
*   **Healthcare Access:** Minutes away from **Sarasota Memorial Hospital** and surrounding specialist plazas.
*   **Why it’s a top choice:** It is exceptionally dog-friendly and features a mature, tree-lined landscape that feels more like a forest than a typical Florida development.

### 4. Village Plaza
This community is located near the intersection of Bee Ridge Road and Beneva Road, putting it in the middle of a major medical and shopping corridor.
*   **HOA Fees:** ~$630/month (includes building insurance, water, sewer, trash, and pest control).
*   **Healthcare Access:** Extremely close to the **Medical Center of Sarasota** and within 10–15 minutes of the main SMH campus.
*   **Why it’s a top choice:** The units are larger than average (up to 1,700+ sq. ft.) and it is walkable to grocery stores and pharmacies.

### 5. LakeRidge Falls
LakeRidge Falls is a gated community known for being "maintenance-free," meaning the HOA handles almost everything exterior.
*   **HOA Fees:** ~$400 – $550/month (no CDD fees).
*   **Healthcare Access:** Located just north of University Parkway, it is roughly 5 minutes from the **SMH University Parkway** facility and 15 minutes from **Lakewood Ranch Medical Center**.
*   **Why it’s a top choice:** It has a very high "pride of ownership" with strict architectural standards, meaning the community stays in pristine condition without the massive price tag of new construction.

### 6. Camelot Lakes Village (Best Budget Option)
This is a manufactured home community, which offers the lowest entry price for housing in Sarasota.
*   **Fees:** Instead of an HOA, you pay a **Monthly Lot Rent** (typically $900 – $1,100). While this sounds high, it includes property taxes, water, lawn care, and gated security, often making the total cost of living lower than a condo with a mortgage + HOA + taxes.
*   **Healthcare Access:** Located near Clark Road, it has quick access to **Sarasota Memorial’s Clark Road Health Care Center**.
*   **Why it’s a top choice:** It offers two clubhouses and two pools, providing a very active social life for a fraction of the cost of a traditional home.

### Summary of Healthcare Hubs in Sarasota:
*   **Sarasota Memorial Hospital (Main Campus):** Best for specialized surgeries and emergencies.
*   **Sarasota Memorial (Venice Campus):** A newer facility serving South Sarasota/Nokomis.
*   **HCA Florida Sarasota Doctors Hospital:** Located on Bee Ridge, excellent for orthopedics and general care.
*   **Lakewood Ranch Medical Center:** Serves the northeastern part of the county.
